name: Lembert Dome Picnic Area / Dog Lake parking lot, Tioga Road
basis: MP Lembert Dome Getting There: park in the paved, signed Lembert Dome Picnic Area lot at the base of the West Face; Yosemite Hikes says that lot is shared with the Dog Lake trailhead. Matched to the mapped Dog Lake Parking lot by name/position (0.9 km from dome); road check: on Tioga Road.

name: Tioga Road pullout for Fairview Dome (south side, west of the meadow)
basis: MP Fairview Dome Getting There: obvious pullout south of the road 3.5 mi from the store and 4 mi from Tenaya Lake; SummitPost places the Fairview lot 1.5 mi east of the Mariuolumne lot. Matched by position: lot is on Tioga Road 0.7 km from the dome.

name: Tioga Road dirt pullouts where Cathedral Creek passes under the road
basis: MP DAFF Area Getting There: park on dirt pullouts on the north side of the road where Cathedral Creek goes under highway 120, just west of Fairview Dome; all sub-areas share this parking. Mapped pullout on Tioga Road ~0.6 km from the area coordinate, just west of the Fairview lot.

name: Large dirt lot on Tioga Road for Mariuolumne and Drug Domes
basis: SummitPost Mariuolumne Dome: large dirt parking area on Hwy 120, 2.5 mi east of Tenaya Lake / 1.5 mi west of Fairview Dome's lot; climbers trail leads to Mariuolumne and Drug Dome. Mapped lot (a parking area) sits on Tioga Road about 1.5 mi west of the Fairview lot.

name: Large dirt lot on Tioga Road for Mariuolumne and Drug Domes
basis: SummitPost: all approaches start on the climbers trail from the large dirt parking area, emerging after a few minutes at the talus below Drug Dome. Same lot as Mariuolumne Dome.

name: Tenaya Lake east-end picnic area parking lot
basis: MP Tenaya Lake Picnic Area Getting There: Tenaya Lake parking lot (on the east end of the lake). Mapped lot is 0.1 km from Tioga Road beside the East Beach Trail, 0.15 km from the area coordinate; another lot 0.4 km west is a weaker fit.

name: May Lake Trailhead parking lot at the end of the May Lake road
basis: MP May Lake route Getting There: park at the May Lake trailhead and hike 1.2 mi to the lake; lot is at the end of the 1.8 mi May Lake road off Tioga Road. Lot is adjacent to the mapped May Lake Trailhead node (3.8 km from the area coordinate).

name: Murphy Creek trailhead on Tioga Road near Tenaya Lake
basis: SummitPost Murphy Creek: ~2 mile hike to the wall; trailhead on north side of Tioga Road near Tenaya Lake (NPS Murphy Creek trailhead). Mapped Murphy Creek Trailhead node, 2.0 km from the crag.
